name: Moc Chau
provinceNote: 2026 news still prints Sơn La province and the wards phường Mộc Châu and phường Thảo Nguyên. Older pages print huyện Mộc Châu and the farm-town name. Both wordings stay.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: Stay for the tea plateau past the Highway 6 pass, not Mai Chau’s rice valley. Moc Chau is the Son La highland where the morning is contour tea, a dairy stop, and Dai Yem. Hanoi bus times disagree, so check the one you book.
getThere: About 200 km from Hanoi on National Highway 6
bestMonths: April to September for the falls; blossom weeks move
seoTitle: Moc Chau travel guide — plateau past the Highway 6 pass
seoDescription: Son La tea plateau after the Highway 6 pass, not Mai Chau’s rice valley. Stay a night. Hanoi buses print about 3 hours 30 minutes and about 5 hours.
intro: You come over the pass and the land opens into tea rows, pasture, and, in the cold weeks, white plum blossom on a valley. Stay if that morning is the trip. Sleep in Mai Chau if you wanted the rice valley before the pass, and do not book Son La city when the plateau night is the point. Vietnam Tourism calls the plateau about 80 km by 25 km and over 1,000 m. The national district page prints 1,050 m. The heritage monograph prints an average of 1,150–1,300 m, with limestone from 1,050 m. A rural-tourism feature prints about 1,500 m. Those four heights stay side by side.

The bed is a small hotel or homestay in the farm town, or a Thai stilt house at Ban Ang. No hotel brand is a pick. After dark the walk is the farm-town walking street and night market around the Pha Luong light park. Festival nights move to Square 08-5 in phường Mộc Châu. A 2023 provincial feature says weekends are the fuller nights. A closing hour was not printed, so check on arrival.

Give the morning to the tea rows or the dairy pasture, then Dai Yem or Na Ka depending on the month. Do not publish one height for Dai Yem. Vietnam Tourism says the drop is over 100 m. The monograph says the first fall drops about 70 m and is in three tiers, with a first tier about 40 m deep, about 70 m wide, and about 50 m high, and puts the two falls about 200 m apart. The national page puts the two falls 150 m apart. The fee and the hours are check on arrival.

Bat Cave, also called Son Moc Huong, stays a roadside cave without its own card until a licensed photograph of the mouth exists. Vietnam Tourism, labeling the figures “Source: Internet,” says over 7,000 square meters, 100 m high, 930 m long, and 240 steps. A travel site, not the heritage office, says about 240 steps, an entrance about 100 m above the road, about 6,915 square meters, a highest point about 20 m, a length about 80 m, and a width about 25 m. Do not treat those as one measurement. The dairy gate is the same kind of split: two visit write-ups, neither the company’s notice, print 08:00–18:00, and one prints 20,000 VND while the other prints 10,000 VND. Check the gate on arrival. Pha Luong is 2,000 m on the Vietnam Tourism page and nearly 2,000 m on a tourism reprint.
gettingAround: The usual start is Hanoi, and the road is National Highway 6. The distance is about 200 km. A rental-car page also prints 198 km on its own reading. Record both. Mai Chau is the valley before the pass, about 70 km from Moc Chau on that same rental page, of which about 60 km is the pass. Minutes on the Mai Chau leg are check on arrival.

redBus, updated 16 Oct 2026, prints an average bus time of 4 hours 10 minutes and about 40 services a day from My Dinh to Moc Chau town. The same page’s prose says the bus is about 4 to 4 hours 30 minutes, a car about 4 hours 30 minutes to 5 hours, and a motorbike about 5 hours. One operator block prints 3 hours 30 minutes and another prints 4 hours 15 minutes. A rental-car page says about 4 to 5 hours. A road-authority duration is check on arrival. The same bus page prints a cheapest fare of 280,000 VND and, in an operator block, 250,000 VND. Those fares disagree, so the fare is check on arrival.

A rural-tourism feature says a newly operational expressway has cut the time from Hanoi and prints no duration. An 8 Oct 2026 inspection says the Hoa Binh–Moc Chau expressway was still being built, at about 16.73 percent of contract value, with a contract opening in the first quarter of 2028. The road you can use on this check is National Highway 6. There is no published commercial flight into Moc Chau or Na San, and no named rail station. Noi Bai in Hanoi is the airport travelers actually use.

On the plateau, National Highway 6 is the spine. National Highway 43 leaves it for Dai Yem, Ban Ang, and Long Sap. The district page says 32 km to the Laos border on that road. The Dai Yem monograph says 33 km. Bicycle and motorbike rentals are offered for the tea hills. A local bus, a taxi fare, or a ride-hailing map inside the plateau is check on arrival. Highway 6 continues west toward Son La city and Dien Bien Phu. Those kilometers are check on arrival.

stayAreas.name: Farm town
stayAreas.summary: Small hotels and homestays on the plateau strip. This is the bed, the morning yogurt, and the night-market walk. The old farm-town name and the 2026 ward names are one base, not two towns.

stayAreas.name: Ban Ang
stayAreas.summary: Thai stilt houses about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43, under the pine. A 2012 feature puts a 5 ha lake here. Horseback is offered. The fee is check on arrival.

eat: The morning cup is cold yogurt or fresh milk in the farm town. A 3 May 2024 provincial announcement ranked an Amifarm set at 3-star OCOP: plain yogurt, black sticky-rice yogurt, and passion-fruit yogurt. That household is not a restaurant pick. Stall hours are check on arrival.

At Ban Ang the sourced plates are bamboo sticky rice, grilled fish, smoked meat, forest greens, and rice wine served from a gourd through a bamboo tube. The food guide’s photograph is the bamboo rice. It was not taken at Ban Ang, and the skewer in the frame is not a sourced pa pỉnh tộp. Chao calf and bamboo-tube fish are named there without a cooking method. The night market, a ground of more than 2 ha around the Pha Luong light park, serves dried buffalo and hearth sausage with rice wine. No stall price was recorded. A separate morning market was not named.
interestsBody: Tea-hill contours are the picture of the plateau. The falls and the Bach Long bridge are the other walks that have a licensed photograph of the sight.
Plum valleys, the dairy herd, Ban Ang’s pine, and the Bat Cave are real, and they stay in the text until a photograph of that subject is licensed.

cards.title: Dining and F&B
cards.summary: For the Ban Ang meal, when you want the bamboo rice that has a plate and can leave the dishes that do not.

body: A 2012 feature names cơm lam among Ban Ang’s local dishes: sticky rice cooked in a bamboo tube. Eat it from the tube. Salt, sesame, and a dipping sauce are not on that page. The photograph is a licensed plate of that dish. It was not taken at Ban Ang, and the skewer beside the rice is not a sourced pa pỉnh tộp. The price is check on arrival.

Yogurt and fresh milk, hau plum, plateau tea, grilled fish, smoked meat, chao calf, bamboo-tube fish, xôi, rice wine from a gourd, forest greens, and festival bánh dày are named and have no licensed plate, so they are not cards. The night market is a ground of more than 2 ha around the Pha Luong light park, with nearly 60 stalls. A 2023 feature says weekends are fuller and names dried buffalo and hearth sausage with rice wine. It prints no clock and no stall photograph. Hours are check on arrival. A separate morning market was not named.

interestGroups.summary: For a morning in the rows, when the picture you came for is the plateau rather than a rice valley.

cards.title: Tea-hill contours
cards.summary: Walk the contour rows. Vietnam Tourism calls the tea ground about 3,000 ha and the largest tea region in Vietnam. A 2019 provincial paper also says more than 3,000 ha and says the tea is less famous than Thai Nguyen tea. Do not publish “largest” as settled. The 2019 free-entry line is not a 2026 fee. Check on arrival, and do not sit on the bushes.

body: The heart-shaped hills are at Tan Lap, reached from the farm town. A 2019 paper names at least three hills. The turns are now old, so check them on arrival.
Moc Suong is the processing visit beside those hills: watch the leaf and an old tea ceremony. The fee is check on arrival. Do not reuse the 2019 line that the hills charged no ticket.

interestGroups.title: Limestone falls
interestGroups.summary: For Dai Yem, when you want the two drops and can live with heights that do not agree.

cards.title: Limestone falls
cards.summary: Dai Yem is the fall you hear before you see it. Keep every published height. The fee is check on arrival.

body: Vietnam Tourism says the drop is over 100 m. The monograph says the first fall drops about 70 m in three tiers, with a first tier about 40 m deep, about 70 m wide, and about 50 m high, and puts the two falls about 200 m apart. The national page puts them 150 m apart.

The national page calls the water fullest from April to September, a sheet about 70 m wide. The monograph says May to September for the first fall’s lip and April to September for the second. Chieng Khoa is named beside Dai Yem and has no height and no fee in the dossier.

interestGroups.title: Bach Long bridge
interestGroups.summary: For the glass span in the hills, not a sea island and not a measured world record.

cards.title: Bach Long bridge
cards.summary: A park Vietnam Tourism calls Moc Chau Island, reached across Bach Long bridge. It prints no length. The world’s-longest line is not a settled measurement.

body: The January 2026 flower program used the site for adventure sports and a market-style space. Ordinary hours and the fee are check on arrival.
It is a built park beside the farms. It is not the tea picture, and it is not a sea island.

faqs.a: Mai Chau is the rice valley on National Highway 6 before the pass. Moc Chau is the tea plateau after it. A Mai Chau photograph does not show this place.

faqs.q: How long is the bus from Hanoi?
faqs.a: redBus, updated 16 Oct 2026, prints an average of 4 hours 10 minutes, a prose range of about 4 to 4 hours 30 minutes, and operator blocks of 3 hours 30 minutes and 4 hours 15 minutes. A rental page says about 4 to 5 hours. Check the bus you book. The fare on that page is not one number.

season.label: Cold dry winter, wet summer
season.note: The district page calls winter cold and dry and summer rainy, with no typhoons, and prints an average annual temperature of about 21ºC. The plateau page prints a summer average of 20ºC. Both stay. Dai Yem is fullest from April to September on the national page. The monograph says May to September for the first fall’s lip and April to September for the second. Plum blossom was called at its best on 8 Jan 2026, and the flower program opened on 17 Jan 2026. The next blossom week moves. Check on arrival. An October 2026 construction note says winter mornings and evenings are foggy on this alignment.
